sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 2). You know dosages, preparations, contraindications. This is real medicine, just old.
📖 LEARNED: Reading the Land (Level 2). Edges are the grocery store — where meadow meets woods, where water meets bank. Disturbed ground regrows first and fattest.
📖 LEARNED: The Forager’s Eye (Level 2). Edges, disturbed ground, last year’s growth — you read a hillside like a menu and strip it clean.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 3 skills from your past — check your Journal.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Kenneth Mikhailov. Florist. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Photo album, Search locket, Energy Bar Wrapper, Dispatcher's headset, Seed packet. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night, something walked past the treeline on two legs. Too tall. It stopped. It listened. Then it kept going. Nobody slept after that.
A woman, maybe 40s, with a slouched posture: "We've got days of stores, not weeks. The treeline is the pantry now. Learn what's out there."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 3L carried (3kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 19L left.
